content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to connect a PIR sensor as a motion detector to a [product_name] [version_no]? I am referring to the same type of PIR sensors used in anti-theft alarm systems. If so, could you provide a wiring diagram?
Welcome to the forum. If you can share the technical specifications of your PIR sensor, or provide a link to its datasheet, someone may be able to assist you further.

According to the datasheet: Power supply is 9-16 VDC; alarm output is NC (relay output, up to 28 VDC, 150 mA max). You will need a separate power supply for the sensor, such as 12 VDC. The relay can switch 12V or 24VDC to a [product_name] digital input, provided the [product_name] uses a 12V or 24VDC supply. The sensor cannot be used with [product_name] devices powered by 230VAC or 24VAC. The datasheet does not include wiring details, so I cannot offer a specific wiring diagram.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to connect a common PIR motion sensor, as used in security systems, to a [product_name] device with a 12/24VDC power supply. The thread discusses voltage compatibility, notes that further information is needed from the PIR sensor's datasheet, and points out that a wiring diagram cannot be provided due to missing datasheet details.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to receive confirmation of compatibility and a specific wiring diagram for connecting a PIR sensor to the [product_name] module for motion detection.
